needs.title: SAP data model per domain (table role + real PK + header/item parent + business meaning)
needs.why: Agent decided merge/no-merge from key heuristics, not the real model -> wrong twice this session (FEBKO/FEBEP header-item, REGUH PK, DORIGIN dedup). The data model is reusable across dedup, joins, process mining, verification.
needs.approach: ECC, NOT S/4. Full model from 3 RFC extractions of SAP own definitions (zero guessing): (1) DD03L.KEYFLAG=real PKs, (2) DD08L+DD03L.CHECKTABLE=foreign keys, (3) LDBN+LDBS=Logical Database tree = standard header->item/parent-child hierarchy (FEBKO->FEBEP, BKPF->BSEG, PERNR->infotypes). CDS=S/4 (N/A); BW content=reporting extractors (not the relational hierarchy). Extractor: scripts/extract_ddic_model.py -> domain_data_model.json.
needs.blocked_on: P01/D01 not active (extractor built, first run pending)
needs.insight: The STANDARD model on ECC = the Logical Database (LDB), native/pre-CDS, whose node tree adopts the tables foreign-key hierarchy. SLDB/SE36. Stored in LDBN/LDBS, RFC-extractable. This is what closes the header/item model that hand-guessing got wrong.

needs.title: Process DISCOVERY (process mining) from logs/transactions/jobs — THE MAIN OBJECTIVE
needs.why: CORRECTED: process maps are NOT a user input — they are the OUTPUT we DISCOVER. Process engineering = discover how the process actually runs from event data (logs, bkpf transactions, jobs, change docs), read the system not the docs. process_ingestor PROCESS_DEFINITIONS being hardcoded is the anti-pattern — they should be DISCOVERED.
needs.approach: Build the event log {case_id, activity, timestamp, resource} from data ALREADY in the Gold DB: case = AWTYP+AWKEY doc-flow chain / business object; activity = TCODE / change / status; timestamp = CPUDT+CPUTM (bkpf) / UDATE+UTIME (cdhdr); resource = USNAM. Sources: bkpf (1.8M, AWKEY 100% populated, 15 AWTYP, 50 tcodes), cdhdr (7.8M change events), tbtcp_history (jobs). Discover variants/sequences/bottlenecks -> feed brain PROCESS spine (STEP_USES_TCODE->program->tables->users). P01 NOT required.
needs.insight: This is the project main objective (SAP Agentic AGI / process mining). The data is local and ready — discovery can start now, not pending user maps or P01.
